data.name: Naru
data.long_meaning: Naru is a Sanskrit name derived from the term Narayana, which refers to Lord Vishnu in his resting form. The name is a compound of 'Nara' (man) and 'Ayana' (rest), symbolizing the divine power that rests in all beings. This name is believed to bestow upon the bearer strength, wisdom, and divine protection.

The name Naru highlights the reverence and connection to the divine in Hindu culture.

The spiritual significance of the name Naru aligns with the Hindu philosophy of 'Atman' (the self) and 'Brahman' (the divine) being interconnected, reaffirming the concept of the divine within.
